title: Execution Algo Engine
description: A new execution-algo-engine component slicing parent orders into TWAP/VWAP child orders submitted through order-matcher's existing order-entry path.

nodes.label: REST caller
nodes.description: Submits a parent order via POST /algo/orders and polls progress.

nodes.label: execution-algo-engine
nodes.description: Schedules TWAP/VWAP buckets, submits child orders, tracks fills, event-sources its own state.

nodes.label: TRADERX_ALGO_ENGINE (JetStream)
nodes.description: Durable append log of parent-order lifecycle events; replayed on boot for crash recovery.

nodes.label: Price Publisher
nodes.description: Existing last-price feed; queried per child order to derive a marketable limit price.

nodes.label: order-matcher (BLP + risk gateway)
nodes.description: Existing order-entry endpoint; children are indistinguishable from manually entered orders.

nodes.label: NATS
nodes.description: Existing broker; execution-algo-engine adds a subscriber on /accounts/*/orders, publishes nothing to core NATS.

nodes.label: Tick Store (Parquet, GCS)
nodes.description: YU07's unified ticks store; queried by the DuckDB volume-profile source for VWAP.

edges.label: Append event, then apply to in-memory state
VWAP: read_parquet(..., hive_partitioning=true) via DuckDB JDBC
